title: ui-baseline.json
description: DOM references to a never-allowed host that the product's UI rendered before the Ever Platform modules existed (a footer link, a documentation link), written once (adopted with check-baseline-shrink --first-version) and allowed to shrink only (check-baseline-shrink --config). An entry excuses the same {route, attribute, url} in the DOM check and nothing else: never a DNS query, a connection attempt, a HAR entry or a request.

base_commit.description: The product commit the entries were recorded from (before the first module change), as a full or abbreviated SHA. check-baseline-shrink requires it to be in the history and refuses any change to it once the file exists.

route.description: The route of ui-routes.json the reference was found on, or, for a page the sign-in goes through, its path.

url.description: As dom-refs.json writes it (query values dropped).
